verdict.rationale: Nexus monitoring is a fair question for a sales-tax compliance product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows manually creating nexus declarations, retrieving nexus definitions and listing transactions. Nothing documents tracking sales or transaction counts against economic-nexus thresholds or alerting before a threshold is crossed. Those are adjacent building blocks, not the monitoring capability itself.

support.subject: As a founder, the product watches my economic nexus exposure — tracking sales and transaction counts against every state and country threshold and alerting me before I cross one, not after
